name: peckit
description: Manage a restaurant, bar or café on Peckit: promotions, events, opening hours, happy hour, tags, reviews, suggestions and analytics.

interface.longDescription:
Peckit is an app for discovering restaurants, bars and cafés in Chile. With this plugin, people who manage a venue on Peckit can run it by chatting, without opening the web dashboard.

What you can do:
- Create and relaunch your venue's promotions, and see which ones perform best.
- Create and cancel events (trivia nights, live music, etc.).
- Check and change opening hours and happy hour.
- Edit the venue's tags (vegan, pet-friendly, terrace…).
- Read user reviews and suggestions, and mark suggestions as reviewed.
- See analytics: views, favorites, visits and redemptions.

Creating or relaunching a promotion, creating an event and cancelling one require your explicit confirmation: new content is published right away and can notify nearby app users, and a cancelled event is deleted permanently.

The plugin only accesses the venues you manage and never returns data that identifies app users. Peckit's data is in Spanish; you can chat in English or Spanish.

Limitations: it doesn't upload photos from the chat, edit the menu or create new tags; those stay in the Peckit manager dashboard. Requires a Peckit manager account linked to your venue (sign up at peckit.cl/manager).
capabilities: Update opening hours and happy hour
defaultPrompt: What do my latest reviews say, and what is my average rating?
How did my promotions perform this month?
On Sunday we open from 12:00 to 17:00, update my hours.

positive.description: Read the venue's reviews. The test account manages one venue, "LOCAL DE PRUEBA" (Valdivia, Chile), Peckit's internal test venue: hidden from the public app and it sends no push notifications, so writes are safe to run.
positive.prompt: What do my latest reviews say, and what is my average rating?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the latest reviews of LOCAL DE PRUEBA with their ratings and the average rating, without identifying who wrote them.

positive.description: Check how the venue's promotions performed.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the venue's promotions with views and redemptions and points out which ones performed best.

positive.description: Update the opening hours for one day.
positive.prompt: On Sunday we open from 12:00 to 17:00, update my hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates Sunday to 12:00–17:00 and confirms the new schedule; the other days stay unchanged. The test venue is hidden from the public app, so the change is safe.

positive.description: Create a promotion, which requires the user's explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: Create a 2-for-1 beer promotion for this Friday from 18:00 to 21:00.
positive.expected_behavior: The promotion is published only after the user confirms (in ChatGPT's approval prompt or in the chat): create_promotion requires confirm: true. It returns the new promotion with its date and details. The test venue sends no notifications.

positive.description: Get an analytics summary for the venue.
positive.prompt: Give me a summary of my analytics for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns aggregated views, favorites, visits and redemptions for LOCAL DE PRUEBA over the last 30 days, with no data that identifies app users.

negative.description: Access to a venue the account doesn't manage. The plugin only covers the venues linked to the signed-in manager, so it should say it can't access that venue instead of returning its data.
negative.prompt: Show me the reviews and analytics of another restaurant in Valdivia that I don't manage.

negative.description: Identifying app users. Reviews and suggestions are returned without the author's identity by design, so it should explain it can't share who wrote them.
negative.prompt: Tell me the name and email of the person who wrote my latest review.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. There is no tool to delete reviews or the venue, so it should explain it can't do it and point to the Peckit manager dashboard or support.
negative.prompt: Delete all the bad reviews of my venue.

review.commerce_description: Peckit doesn't sell products or process payments. Promotions are offers a venue publishes in the Peckit app and redeems in person at the venue; the plugin only lets the venue's own manager create and track them.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: manage a Peckit venue's promotions, events, opening hours, happy hour, tags, reviews, suggestions and analytics.

es-419.subtitle: Gestiona tu local en Peckit
es-419.description:
Peckit es la app para descubrir restaurantes, bares y cafés en Chile. Con este plugin, quien administra un local en Peckit lo gestiona conversando, sin abrir el panel web.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Crear y relanzar las promociones de tu local, y ver cuáles funcionan mejor.
- Crear y cancelar eventos (trivia, música en vivo, etc.).
- Revisar y cambiar el horario y el happy hour.
- Editar los tags del local (vegano, pet-friendly, terraza…).
- Leer reseñas y sugerencias de usuarios, y marcar sugerencias como revisadas.
- Ver estadísticas: vistas, favoritos, visitas y canjes.

Crear o relanzar una promoción, crear un evento y cancelarlo exigen tu confirmación explícita: lo nuevo se publica de inmediato y puede avisar a usuarios cercanos, y un evento cancelado se elimina para siempre.

Solo accede a los locales que administras y nunca entrega datos que identifiquen a los usuarios de la app.

Limitaciones: no sube fotos desde el chat, no edita el menú ni crea tags nuevos; eso sigue en el panel de manager de Peckit. Requiere una cuenta de manager en Peckit vinculada a tu local (regístrate en peckit.cl/manager).
